title: Smoother animation ≠ Better animation [read pinned comment]
summary: Animator Noodle explains why frame interpolation does not make animation better, covering timing, easing, smear frames and using the wrong tool for the job. A pinned correction says the video is partly outdated given later AI developments.
why: HN commenters recommend it in motion-smoothing and interpolation threads as an overview of why interpolation hurts animation.

quote.text: A really good video on the subject
